description.value: Sushi Kaido is a Japanese restaurant at the busy Main and Broadway intersection in Vancouver, serving handcrafted sushi and Japanese cuisine with indoor seating. The restaurant offers online ordering with a rewards program, and has expanded into catering for schools and companies. It sits on a major cycling corridor connecting east Vancouver to the city centre.
